You've done really well with this logic @lilitkarapetyan - there's some complex stuff going on.

In the next block, it "looks like" `chosenTemplates` will contain the templates for all of the participating roles in the channel.  I _think_ it should only contain the templates for _my_ role.  So, `Blue` could have some templates and `White` could have others.
No, I was mistaken.  The chosenTemplates is the union of the ways this role can participate in the channel, which is correct :-)

issues.title: Channel memberships update live, but not role permissions
issues.body:
During a game we can make live changes to which channel a user in.

But, when we decide channel membership, we only use the role permissions that were loaded when the game started.

So, we will need to either:
1. retrieve the `live` role information and pass it to `handleMessageUpdates`
2. update role details on new wargame update

Actually, the second makes more sense - since other parts of the UI will probably need to know the updated role permissions (such as `canSubmitOrders`, `insightViewer` or `rfiManager`)

Steps to reproduce:
* edit wargame, don't give Game Control permission to release RFIs (RFI Manager)
* log in as `Blue Force` \ `CO`, create new RFI message in `Blue RFIs`
* log in as `Game control`. Go to `RFIs` channel
* take ownership of new RFI
* provide response
* press `Send for review`
* see no `Release` or `Reject` buttons present
* edit wargame, give Game Control `isRFIManager` permission. Save wargame
* note that `Release` & `Reject` buttons still not present
* refresh page
* note that `Release` & `Reject` buttons now present

The issue is that the client received the new `Forces` object when it got saved, but the Player State object didn't get updated.

I _guess_ that `SET_ROLE` needs to be called when `SET_FORCE` does.  Hmm, maybe not.
